# MyIsn.Android — Current State

**Snapshot date:** 2026-09-28
**Generated by:** /document-projects

## Tech stack
Kotlin 2.1.20, AGP 8.13.2, Gradle Kotlin DSL + composite `build-logic/` convention-plugin build. compileSdk/targetSdk 36, minSdk 30. Jetpack Compose (Material3) is the forward path; legacy XML/DataBinding (`BaseFragment`) is being phased out.

## Architecture
Clean Architecture + MVVM, 3 Gradle modules: `:app` (UI containers, ViewModels, Navigation, app-level DI), `:data` (Repositories, UseCases, network layer, DI, no dependency on `:app`/`:compose`), `:compose` (reusable composables, design system, feature screens, theme, no dependency on `:app`/`:data`). DI via Koin 4.x (`AppModule`, `DataModules`, `UseCasesModules`, `IsnServiceFactory`). Data flow: `IsnService` (Retrofit) → `IsnApi`/`IsnApiImpl` → Repository → ViewModel; reads via `BaseCachingRepository.getApiCall()` (cache-first `Flow<ApiResult<T>>`), mutations return `suspend fun: ApiResult<T>` directly.

## Key features/flows found
~40 feature areas under `app/.../ui/` (mirrored in `:compose`'s ~42 screen folders): accountreactivation, acknowledgement, addDocument, addisnid, auth, checkyouremail, connections, contractors, coursecertificates, deletepersonalinfo, devoptions, documents, documentviewer, favorites, findisnid, folderdetails, geolocation, hazardassistant, home, notifications, notificationssettings, onboarding, photopicker, profile, quickcheck, scannableisnid, search, securityprivacy, settings, simplenotification, splash, toolboxTalks, tools, training, troubleverifying, visits, wallet, workerforms, writtenprograms.

## Networking / API layer
Retrofit + Moshi + OkHttp + Chucker (debug/internalRelease only). `EnvironmentRepository` switches between `DEV`/`STG`/`STG_AUTO`/`PRODUCTION`/`MOCKING` (locked to production in `productionRelease` builds). `MOCKING` points at a user-overridable local Mockoon URL (needs an `empower`-prefixed base URL + Charles Proxy SSL mapping + a self-signed cert loaded only in the internal flavor). Auth: MSAL/Azure AD B2C, `Authorization: Bearer` + `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` headers injected outside the mocking environment. 118 Retrofit endpoints in `IsnService.kt` — see `docs/api-contracts.md` for the full domain breakdown.

## Third-party SDKs
Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, Remote Config, FCM, Dynamic Links), Pendo (private Artifactory), Qualtrics (private S3 Maven), MSAL (Microsoft Azure DevOps Maven feed), Radar SDK (geolocation), Google ML Kit/CameraX/ZXing (QR/barcode), Google Play Integrity API, RootBeer (root detection), LeakCanary + ANR-WatchDog (debug-only), Timber (logging), Google Wallet (ISN ID card).

## Testing
JUnit4, Mockito(+kotlin), Google Truth, Turbine, Robolectric, kotlinx-coroutines-test, Koin-test, androidx navigation/workmanager/paging testing. **100% coverage required for all new code in `:app`/`:data`**, enforced via Kotlin Kover (JaCoCo backend) at 85% line / 75% branch minimum; `:compose` is excluded from the coverage requirement. Run: `./gradlew test`, `connectedAndroidTest`, `ktlintCheck`/`ktlintFormat`, `detekt`, `koverHtmlReport`.

## Known gaps
- Legacy `BaseFragment` (DataBinding) migration to `BaseFragmentCompose` is in progress, not finished.
- README's "Updating Dependencies" section is literally unwritten (`-TBD`).
- Two feature flags carry inline dev-notes questioning their own design (`MyCompaniesComposeNavigationFeatureFlag`, `QualtricsSDKFlag`); `ComposeNavigationFlag`/`QcComposeNavFlag` are explicitly local-only, in-flight Compose-navigation migrations.
- `docs/BEST_PRACTICES.md` (in-repo) is stale — still describes a 2-module layout, predates `:compose`.
- PII/token logging risks (raw MSAL token, raw JWT, raw FCM token logged via Timber, reachable in `internalRelease` builds) — see `docs/observability.md`. Not self-reported in the repo's own docs.
